Hi Sofia — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and the small items we need to keep momentum: 

1) Use case & priority
- You confirmed prioritizing patient intake summarization for Q4 pilot.
- Main success metrics: latency < 600ms at 95th pct, cost target ~ $0.004/token.

2) Technical checklist
- We'll share the demo workspace and model profile (see attached quote).
- Suggested pilot config: 1x dedicated GPU slot, prefix caching enabled.

3) Procurement/vendor setup items (what your team needs from us)
- W-9 (attached)
- ACH remittance form (we can provide)
- Vendor portal invite — please confirm which email to send the invite to (procurement or vendor-ops).

Next steps
- I attached our quote (Redwood-quote-Holloway-2026-07.pdf). Please share with procurement.
- If procurement prefers, I can loop in our internal ops contact, or you can push the portal invite to the address you control.

If this still looks like a fit, can we target a procurement handoff this week?

Thanks,

Hi Sofia / Marco — attaching the standard one-page pricing (and the detailed quote we discussed). Pilot start depends on procurement timing but operationally we can spin up a pilot environment within 5 business days of vendor activation.

What procurement usually needs from our side:
- Completed W-9 (attached: W9-Redwood-2026.pdf)
- Signed quote or PO number (we can accept PO by email)
- Preferred vendor contact for the portal invite (email for vendor admin)
